chunks: And in the narration of Rifa‘ah ibn Musa, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم appointed al-ʿAqīq for the people of Najd, and he said: “It is an appointed time for whatever land rises toward Najd, and you are among them.” And he appointed al-Juḥfah for the people of al-Shām, and it is said to it: Mahyaʿah.

key_terms.الْجُحْفَةَ: al-Juḥfah, the miqat designated for the people of al-Shām
key_terms.الْعَقِيقَ: al-ʿAqīq, the miqat designated for the people of Najd
key_terms.نَجْدٍ: Najd, the elevated central region referred to in the hadith
key_terms.وَقَّتَ: appointed or designated a fixed time/place
key_terms.وَقْتٌ: an appointed time or designated limit, here meaning miqat

ai.seo_question: What miqat did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم appoint for the people of Najd and al-Shām?
ai.summary: This hadith states the miqat locations designated by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for different regions entering iḥrām for hajj. It identifies al-ʿAqīq for the people of Najd and al-Juḥfah for the people of al-Shām, showing the legal organization of pilgrimage entry points.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2523 - In a narration by Rifa‘ah ibn Musa from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:

"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) designated Al-‘Aqiq as the miqat (station for assuming Ihram) for the people of Najd, and he said: 'It is the miqat for wherever the land rises towards Najd.' You are among them.
He also designated Al-Juhfa as the miqat for the people of Sham (Syria), and it is also called Mahya‘ah."
